note: The larger starter island (docs/future/13 section 3.11) for every island made after the keeper's camp update; islands made before keep starter-island.json. The same fields as starter-island.json (see its note), with the plateau, the hill, the pond hollow and the spring scaled with the radius (29.5 to 36 m). chunkMin, chunkMax: the open land (4 x 4 chunks, -80 to 48 m). center: the island's center in the world, the middle of that block; every position below (rise, basin, camp) is measured from it. cameraRadiusM: how far from the center the view above may roam (camera.json worldRadius, 32 for the old island). shape: the coast's larger shapes, all from the seed. lobes: low-frequency coves and headlands (amount in meters), calm within calmDeg of the camp's facing so the camp always looks down a sand beach. spit: a short low tongue of sand lengthM out and widthM across, on a bearing fromCampDeg (a range) round from the camp's facing. rocky: one point lengthM out, widthM across, fromSpitDeg (a range, either side) round from the spit, painted rock (paint 0..1). camp: the keeper's camp (docs/future/13 section 3.4).

dune.note: October 29, 2026 (Matt): a low dune on the shore beside the camp, so chamomile always has dry sandy turf above the tide. fromCampDeg: its bearing round from the camp's facing (a range, the side from the seed). alongM, acrossM: its length along the coast and its width across it. inlandM: its crest this far in from the coast. heightM: how much it lifts the ground there. sand: the sand share of its turf (chamomile wants 0.2 to 0.8).

spring.note: As starter-island.json's spring (docs/07), with fromBasinM scaled with the radius.

materials.sandFloorNote: On the shore ramp, ground below sandFloorM (m) is sand all along, fading to the noise's sand and grass over sandFloorSoftM above it, so no grass lies where the spring high tide (0.69 m) and its waves reach. Pond beds keep their own ground.

camp.note: The keeper's camp (docs/future/13 section 3; src/world/camp). Read it through campOf() in src/world/terrain/landform.js, which gives world meters. inBase: the pad is levelled into this land's base (false: stamped on an older island's first load instead). x, z: pad center (m from the island's center). facingDeg: null faces outward from the island's center; a number overrides (0 is +x, 90 is +z). radiusM, heightM: the level pad, its center at heightM; fallM: how far it falls toward the sea from its center to its seaward edge (and rises to its landward edge), so it sheds rain (F1); blendM: the soft fall back to natural ground; lockFadeM: brushes fade from nothing at the edge to full over this much; dash: the edge drawn on brush contact; wear: the trodden look (0..1) with edgeWearM; grassScale: grass height on the pad. Slots in the pad's frame: u seaward, v left facing the sea. faces: a bench turns so that you work at it facing that slot (the workbench and the apothecary bench face the ring, 3.12); on: it stands on that slot's thing (the mortar on the apothecary bench). mooring: the boat's stake, found by walking out along the facing line to the first ground at stakeLevelM; boatOutM: how far beyond the stake the boat lies on its rope. kingTideMarginM: any king tide must peak this far under heightM. Corners (option A, Matt, October 30, 2026): the fire is the middle; the hearth faces the sea, work (workbench, clay furnace, hamper, piles, the three loose heaps) is on the -v side, herbs (apothecary bench, mortar, rack, dye pot, jar) on the +v side, home (tent, lamp at its door, keepsake shelf, chime off the rack's end) at the back; the animals' things go to the edge (the gift stone on the landward rim, the nest box on the rim toward the hen's bushes, the birdbath off the pad by the bed). yaw inward: turned to face the pad's middle, d toward it and w across (the keepsake shelf); frontM: room kept clear in front of it. rim: placed when made on the pad's rim, rM from the middle, at the bearing of the hen's home bushes or the nearest place gapM clear stepping stepDeg either way up to maxDeg (layout.js rimSpot), saved on its slot record; with no bushes it stands at its own u, v (the home corner). offPad: the slot stands on plain ground just off the pad (the birdbath by the bed). The tests keep every slot apart and on the pad (tools/unit-tests-camp-layout.js).

wearLook.note: The trodden look in terrain-draw.wgsl: wear turns grass to the soil material; albedoLift: packed dry earth reflects this much more than loose soil; dry: share of the wetness it sheds; mossKeep: share of the moss that survives full wear.

story.note: The island's own past under the ground (docs/future/13 10.7.7; src/world/dig/story.js): the starter island always has exactly one old hearth 8 to 20 m from the camp pad and the keeper's cache under one marked stone 12 to 30 m from it. letter: the cache's letter (recipes/world/keeper-cache.json).
